title: Waste of money
text: Waste of money. I thought this would be an uplifting and fun gift to myself especially during the pandemic when I am at home more than usual.  Unfortunately, the fragrance dissipates within about 30-45 seconds after you spray.  What a waste of money.  I guess I got what I paid for.
